title: Defining Reprogramming Checkpoints from Single-Cell Analyses of Induced Pluripotency
assessment: Positive chemically assisted pluripotency evidence in OSKM-expressing embryonic mouse fibroblasts. Normal karyotype and three-germ-layer teratomas reported for derived lines; no demonstrated BUBR1 rescue or muscle benefit.

model.cells: Primary male and female E13.5 embryonic fibroblasts from reprogrammable 129SV/Jae/C57BL6J mice
model.genetic_background: Homozygous Col1a1 inducible Oct4-2A-Klf4-2A-IRES-Sox2-2A-c-Myc cassette; Rosa26 rtTA homozygous or heterozygous
model.genetic_requirement: 2 micrograms/mL doxycycline starts OSKM/OKSM expression on day0; study is chemically assisted transgenic reprogramming, not solely chemical reprogramming
model.culture: ESC medium with knockout DMEM, 15% FBS, L-glutamine, Pen/Strep, NEAA, 2-mercaptoethanol and LIF; irradiated MEF feeders; 0.1% gelatin-coated coverslips.
model.comparison: FBS/ESC-medium reprogramming with the same genetic induction versus A2S and the A2, AS and S2 component-omission combinations.

regimen.identity: Current exact manufacturer catalog maps to L-ascorbic acid 2-phosphate sesquimagnesium salt hydrate, CAS 1713265-25-8. Historical study lot/COA unverified; do not substitute plain ascorbic acid or oral vitamin C.
DOT1L inhibitor; chemically distinct from EPZ-5676/pinometostat and EPZ004777.
MEK inhibitor; the other component of 2i; existing new-mirdametinib identity.

schedule.refresh: Doxycycline and small-molecule medium replaced every two days.
schedule.population_colony_endpoint: NANOG colonies counted at the stated day or four additional days after withdrawal of both doxycycline and small molecules.
schedule.single_cell_endpoint: One tdTomato-positive cell sorted per well; doxycycline and chemicals withdrawn on day 11; AP-positive wells scored on day 15.
schedule.isolated_lines: Day-6 A2S colonies picked and passaged several times in FBS or A2S ESC medium.
schedule.vehicle_matching: Not specified in accessible main Methods. Current product solubility recommendations do not establish study solvent.

outcomes.result: A2S: approximately 1,900 colonies and 42% efficiency on day 6. FBS: approximately 3.2% efficiency, most transgene-independent by day 12.
outcomes.denominator: 5,000 cells initially plated; actual adherent cell count on day 0 used for efficiency, not automatically 5,000.
outcomes.replicates: Figure 1A-B: SD of two replicate samples; Methods: two or more biological replicates per set.
outcomes.statistics: No explicit between-group colony-yield p-value or test reported in read legend/main.

outcomes.result: A2S NANOG-positive colonies were independent of continued induction after day 4, FBS by day 9; checked four additional days after withdrawal.
outcomes.boundary: Sustained marker-positive colonies after induction removal support completed reprogramming; not a muscle-function outcome.

outcomes.result: Approximately 40% AP-positive wells under A2S; two independent experiments.
outcomes.denominator: Wells with tdTomato-positive cells, not automatically all 96 wells.
outcomes.boundary: Day-11 withdrawal/day-15 scoring; do not report this as 40% single-cell success measured on day 6. Exact AP-positive/total integers unavailable without the Figure 1 image.

outcomes.result: Primary Results report day-6-derived lines propagated in FBS, karyotypically normal, and producing teratomas with all three germ layers; transcriptional clustering resembles FBS ESCs.
outcomes.evidence_depth: Supplement S1A-B not accessed visually; detailed methods, denominators, number of clones and animals unresolved.
outcomes.boundary: Preserve this positive beyond transient-marker evidence; does not prove every daughter has faithful chromosomes, correction of pre-existing aneuploidy, absence of genomic variants or therapeutic safety.

outcomes.result: Day-6 S2 yielded roughly half the A2S colony count; A2 efficiency 6.6%; AS 10.4%. All dual-combination colonies retain NANOG after withdrawal. Single-component effects were described as lower, with data not shown.
outcomes.replicates: Figure 6A: SD from two replicate samples.
outcomes.boundary: 2i was tested as one combined factor; individual CHIR versus PD effects cannot be isolated. Cooperative network/yield results do not establish a formal drug-interaction synergy metric or monotherapy efficacy.

bub1b.measurement: Bub1b mRNA in single-cell RNA sequencing, grouped with Mcm6/Ccnb1 cell-cycle genes in Figure 2C/Table S1. Main Results explicitly discuss selection of already cycling cells as an alternative to induction.
bub1b.inference: A2S retains cycling transcript patterns relative to FBS; no selective BUBR1 increase, protein stabilization or spindle-checkpoint correction established.

mechanism.supported: Transcriptomic modules suggest 2i suppresses somatic gene programs, while AA and SGC jointly support pluripotency-network activation; component omissions alter colony yield and transcription.
mechanism.causal_genetics: siRNA studies concern Ehf, Eif4a1 and Phlda2, not Bub1b.
limits: Network edges are inferred statistical associations, not direct binding evidence.
No study-specific chemical-target selectivity or target-engagement experiment shown in the accessible main text.
No claim that all A2S cells stop senescence: Ink4a is still activated and p53 transcripts maintained; cell cycling differs from restoration of tissue health.

functional_and_safety_boundary.pluripotency_positive: Withdrawal-resistant colonies, expandable lines and reported three-germ-layer teratomas.
functional_and_safety_boundary.karyotype_positive: Reported normal endpoint line karyotype; sampling depth unresolved.
not_measured_or_not_established: Germline contribution, chimera competence or tetraploid complementation by these study-derived lines
functional_and_safety_boundary.tumor_boundary: Teratoma formation is deliberately used as an in-vivo pluripotency test; it is not evidence of reduced tumor risk. The OSKM cassette includes c-Myc. No clinical therapeutic hazard estimate computed; no claim that this protocol caused malignant cancer.

current_research_identity: Exact supplier catalog listings checked in September 2026. Catalog identity does not authenticate the historical lot, guarantee stock or establish clinical availability.

source_scope.main: Complete continuous primary text, STAR Methods, key resources and all seven main figure legends read.
source_scope.images_and_supplements: No main figure image or supplement successfully accessed. S1A-B karyotype and teratoma results are retained as primary Results reports, with clone, metaphase and animal denominators unresolved.
